The '''SGS-S1 Condor''' was a [[Gunship/Legends|gunship]] model produced by [[Republic Sienar Systems/Legends|Republic Sienar Systems]] for the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]], which made use of the Condor during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The SGS-S1 was developed over the course of a [[Standard decade/Legends|decade]] by Sienar, who designed it to be able to survive long battles and have a limited close combat capacity. In exchange for a limited sensor range and ammunition capacity, the Condor could carry dogfighting missiles and more powerful short-range [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] as its secondary and close-range weaponry, and was faster and more maneuverable than most other gunships.<ref name="GS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The SGS-S1 Condor is one of the five gunship models available to Republic players in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Starfighter]]'', a [[2013]] Digital Expansion to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. It costs 5,000 Fleet Requisition to unlock, and is the Republic faction's balanced-range gunship, with the [[GSS-4Y Jurgoran]] as its Imperial counterpart.<ref name="GS" />
